description: Construct an equilateral triangle in GeoGebra. Create a triangle where all three sides are equal in length and all three angles are 60 degrees (within ±2° tolerance). You may use any method to DETERMINE the vertex positions (compass/circle construction, the Regular Polygon tool, direct coordinate entry, or manual placement), but you MUST use the Polygon tool to CONNECT the three vertices (select Polygon from toolbar, then click the three vertices in order and close by clicking the first vertex again). The Polygon tool is required for verification. Save the construction as 'equilateral_triangle.ggb' in ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/
